title: Scope-Drift Protected Paths
description: Always-protected paths checked by .claude/scripts/shared/scope-drift-check.js. Touching one of these paths during a /work sub-issue requires the issue body to name it explicitly (or a Scope-Override: line). Schema-driven so CI catches drift between the file and the consumer.

version.description: Schema version of this metadata file. Bump on breaking shape changes.

pattern.description: Glob pattern (minimatch syntax) matched against repo-relative paths. Use '**' for recursive directories.

reason.description: Why this path is protected. Surfaced to the user when the gate halts.

registrarExemption.description: Exempts the paths /work Step 4e's register-helper.js necessarily edits from the always-protected halt (#2788), but ONLY on a run carrying the registrar's full signature. Optional: an absent block exempts nothing, which is the strict direction — absence must never widen a gate.

triggerPatterns.description: Glob patterns identifying a registrar run. EVERY pattern must match at least one touched path before any exemptPattern applies. minItems is 2 deliberately: a single pattern cannot express a co-occurrence signature, and any one of these patterns alone describes ordinary work.

exemptPatterns.description: Always-protected paths exempt from the halt on a registrar run. Still reported, and still raise advisory outside-declared-scope violations.

reason.description: Why these paths are exempt. Surfaced in the gate report.
